findings.description: Direct inspection of all five V187 views and six pose renders: the lower-front UpperLeg weight adjustment is present, but the skirt remains strongly faceted and angular across front, side and rear. In crouch, broad upper-thigh and shorts areas remain visible below the overskirt; in sit, the front lap still separates from the raised thighs and the skirt gathers behind the pelvis. The pose response and coverage remain unacceptable.

The V187 front and side views still show angular planar shading on the bodice and a small gray patch near the waist; the rear waist flap remains stiff. The surface ownership/cause of the waist patch is unverified. Bodice appearance remains unacceptable.

nextAction: Keep REJECT. Before further geometry changes, build a color-coded, same-camera comparison of V186 and V187 for crouch and sit. Quantify visible shorts area (px²) and identify whether each front hem/lap passes above or below the corresponding thigh; preserve all fit and release gates.
